_comment: Browsers that neither Google's privileged-apps list nor the community list
names, whose signing certificates we verified ourselves (issue #125).
Same format and same meaning as the other two lists: being here means this
app's claimed webDomain is believed, so an entry is only ever added from the
vendor's own distribution channel, and only after checking the certificate
in the APK by hand. Each entry records where it came from so the check is
A fingerprint that does not match a given user's install simply fails, and
they are left exactly where they were before the entry existed. So the risk
of an entry is not 'it might not match' — it is 'it might match something
that is not really that browser'. That is why provenance is recorded and why
nothing goes in here from a mirror, an APK aggregator, or a search result.
These two are the channels we could verify. Play Store installs may carry a
different certificate where the vendor uses Play App Signing; those users
keep the pre-#125 behaviour until the Play certificate can be confirmed.
The remaining unpinned browsers (Ecosia, Opera GX, UC) are still open.

Official kiwibrowser GitHub organisation. APK signature schemes v1, v2 and v3 all carry the same certificate, subject 'CN=Arnaud GRANAL, O=Geometry OU, C=EE' — Kiwi Browser's author — self-signed, valid 2018-03-25 to 2045-08-10.
